Nov. 25 Mrs. Anna Asher - 52 - Eye infect - operation tomorrow John Feltron - 30 - bad company - mother heart sick at threatened marriage
Gaylord McIssac - looking for baptismal papers Mrs. Bodery - 70 - stroke Saturday Parpart Baby - 3 next month
December
1941, December
Thanks - Mattie Mrs. Richmond - 47 - had lukemia, given up. En- rolled and enrolled perpetually, is astonishing doctors - getting well again.
Dec. 1 Helen Wejrowski - 39 - run over by city bus - back broken etc
1 Anna Scherer - 52 - operation for T.B. operation Today i.2. 2nd
2 Anna Snoden - 48 - drinking and indiffrent to church and religion for long - mental - feared.
Page 9
Dec. 2 Bernard Verpoort - 46 - threatening tuomer on sholder and neck Thos. Piscopink - 12 - of Wayne of Sr. Solanus .. . killed saving little boy friend.
Baby Rita Joan Badalamenti - 18 mo. - 105-5 fever. ..
V. Sister M. Augustine - 30 - pneumonia - only daughter - not ex- pected to live till night.
James Bruce - 8 - leg broken two weeks ago ... not healing as it ought ...
Clement Gabriel - 10 - broken knee pushing a little boy-friend, saved life of one - one - 8 - killed.
3 Robert Alderman - 17 tomorrow - lutheran - Epileptic.
4 Wm Hayes and Associates - for favorable ajustments .... flat-rent Patti Hayes - 2'2 - eye better
